detail.longDescription:
QuickDoc: PDF Reader Tools is a powerful and easy-to-use PDF file viewing and editing tool that helps you manage and process local documents efficiently.

✨ Core features:
- Multi-format document preview: Supports quick viewing of mainstream document formats such as PDF, Word, Excel, and PPT, with clear content and smooth loading.
- PDF editing tool: Built-in brush and text addition functions, making it easy to annotate and mark PDF files.
- Image to PDF: One-click batch conversion of images on your phone to PDF, with automatic layout for easy archiving and sharing.
- Import and Classification Management: Supports importing local documents, allowing for collection, classification, and deletion, making organization more worry-free.
- Document Search: Quickly find the target document by file name or keyword to improve the efficiency of reference.

📌 Special reminder: Only PDF documents are supported for editing. Files in other formats (such as Word, Excel, PPT) can only be viewed and not modified.

Permission Statement
In order to ensure the normal operation of core functions, the application needs to apply for the following permissions:
-MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Used for scanning, importing, viewing, and managing local document files.
-FOREGROUND_SRVICE_SPECIAL_USE: Keep the background running continuously when processing large PDF files to prevent task interruptions.
We strictly adhere to privacy protection principles and only use relevant permissions after user authorization. All data processing is completed locally.
